meaning.en: Of heroic stature and upright character.
meaning.zh: 头顶着天，脚踩着地，形容形象高大、气概豪迈。

examples.zh: 做人要做顶天立地的人。
examples.en: Be a person who stands tall and upright.

examples.zh: 他是个顶天立地的男子汉，说到做到。
examples.en: He's a man of real stature — he does what he says.

examples.zh: 英雄们顶天立地的形象深入人心。
examples.en: The heroes' towering image lives on in people's hearts.

usage.en: Attributive; often 顶天立地的男子汉.
usage.zh: 多作定语，常说“顶天立地的男子汉”。

meaning.en: A group with no unity or cohesion.
meaning.zh: 像一盘散开的沙子，比喻集体不团结，力量分散。

examples.zh: 这支球队毫无配合，简直是一盘散沙。
examples.en: The team has no coordination at all — they're a rabble.

examples.zh: 没有好的领导，公司就是一盘散沙。
examples.en: Without good leadership, a company falls apart.

examples.zh: 我们班以前是一盘散沙，现在团结多了。
examples.en: Our class used to have no unity, but now we pull together.

usage.en: Predicate or object; often 是一盘散沙.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“是一盘散沙”。

antonyms: 一根筷子易折，十根筷子难断
地无分南北，人无分老幼

meaning.en: Without caring about anything or anyone; recklessly.
meaning.zh: 什么都不管，什么都不顾及。

examples.zh: 他不管不顾地冲进了火场。
examples.en: Heedless of the danger, he rushed into the burning building.

examples.zh: 她对孩子不管不顾，整天打麻将。
examples.en: She neglects her children completely and plays mahjong all day.

examples.zh: 一生气，他就不管不顾地大喊大叫。
examples.en: When he gets angry he shouts without caring who hears.

meaning.en: To pass on a mistake or rumour so that it spreads further and further.
meaning.zh: 把本来就错误的话又错误地传出去，越传越错。

examples.zh: 网上的说法以讹传讹，越传越离谱。
examples.en: The story online got more absurd with every retelling.

examples.zh: 这个错误的读音以讹传讹，很多人都读错了。
examples.en: This wrong pronunciation has been passed on so widely that many people get it wrong.

examples.zh: 没有核实的消息不要转发，以免以讹传讹。
examples.en: Don't share unverified news, or you'll just spread misinformation.

meaning.en: The rights and wrongs of a matter.
meaning.zh: 正确和错误，有理和无理。

examples.zh: 这件事的是非曲直，大家心里都有数。
examples.en: Everyone knows the rights and wrongs of this.

examples.zh: 法院会判明是非曲直。
examples.en: The court will decide the merits of the case.

examples.zh: 不了解是非曲直，就不要乱下结论。
examples.en: Don't jump to conclusions without knowing the rights and wrongs.

meaning.en: A plan made wholly in one's own favour, usually doomed to fail.
meaning.zh: 只从自己愿望出发打的算盘，比喻一厢情愿的打算。

examples.zh: 他的如意算盘落空了。
examples.en: His wishful plans came to nothing.

examples.zh: 想不劳而获？你打错如意算盘了。
examples.en: Get something for nothing? You've got another think coming.

examples.zh: 开发商的如意算盘被新政策打破了。
examples.en: The new policy wrecked the developer's cosy calculations.

usage.en: Object; often 打如意算盘 / 如意算盘落空.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“打如意算盘”“如意算盘落空”。

meaning.en: To stir up trouble or unrest.
meaning.zh: 掀起风浪，比喻挑起事端，制造混乱。

examples.zh: 总有少数人在网上兴风作浪。
examples.en: There are always a few people online stirring up trouble.

examples.zh: 他在公司里兴风作浪，搞得人心惶惶。
examples.en: He's been stirring things up at the company, and everyone is on edge.

examples.zh: 决不允许黑恶势力兴风作浪。
examples.en: Criminal gangs must never be allowed to run riot.

meaning.en: One's whole life; for ever.
meaning.zh: 一辈子。

examples.zh: 我要一生一世陪着你。
examples.en: I'll stay with you for the rest of my life.

examples.zh: 这份恩情我一生一世也忘不了。
examples.en: I'll never forget this kindness as long as I live.

examples.zh: 他们许下了一生一世的誓言。
examples.en: They made vows to be together for life.

usage.en: Adverbial or attributive; common in love vows.
usage.zh: 多作状语、定语，多用于爱情誓言。

meaning.en: Exposed to wind and sun; working hard outdoors.
meaning.zh: 被风吹，被太阳晒，形容在外奔波劳碌。

examples.zh: 常年风吹日晒，他的脸又黑又粗。
examples.en: Years out in all weathers have left his face dark and rough.

examples.zh: 快递员每天风吹日晒，十分辛苦。
examples.en: Couriers work out in all weathers every day — it's a hard job.

examples.zh: 这块广告牌经过风吹日晒，颜色都褪了。
examples.en: Exposed to the elements, the billboard has faded.

meaning.en: Spotlessly clean; figuratively, untouched by bad influences.
meaning.zh: 原为佛教用语，指不受尘世污染；今形容非常干净，也比喻品格高洁。

examples.zh: 她把家里打扫得一尘不染。
examples.en: She keeps the house spotless.

examples.zh: 他当官多年，一尘不染。
examples.en: In all his years in office, he was never tainted by corruption.

examples.zh: 实验室的地板一尘不染。
examples.en: The laboratory floor is spotlessly clean.

meaning.en: Recklessly bold, doing whatever one likes.
meaning.zh: 胆子很大，毫无顾忌地胡作非为。

examples.zh: 这伙人胆大妄为，竟在白天抢劫银行。
examples.en: The gang was so brazen they robbed a bank in broad daylight.

examples.zh: 他胆大妄为，伪造了公司的公章。
examples.en: He had the audacity to forge the company seal.

examples.zh: 对这种胆大妄为的行为必须严惩。
examples.en: Such brazen behaviour must be severely punished.

natural: a hundred schools of thought contend

meaning.en: Many schools of thought freely debating; originally the Warring States era.
meaning.zh: 原指春秋战国时期各学派互相争论的局面，今指不同学术观点自由争论。

equivalents: a hundred schools of thought contend

examples.zh: 春秋战国时期出现了百家争鸣的局面。
examples.en: The Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods saw a hundred schools of thought contend.

examples.zh: 学术研讨会上百家争鸣，气氛热烈。
examples.en: The symposium was a lively clash of ideas.

examples.zh: 网络时代，各种观点百家争鸣。
examples.en: In the internet age, all kinds of views compete freely.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often paired with 百花齐放.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常与“百花齐放”连用。

meaning.en: The causes and effects of something; the full story.
meaning.zh: 事情的起因和结果，泛指事情的整个过程。

examples.zh: 先把事情的前因后果弄清楚再说。
examples.en: Let's get the whole story straight first.

examples.zh: 记者详细报道了事故的前因后果。
examples.en: The reporter covered the causes and consequences of the accident in detail.

examples.zh: 他向老师讲了打架的前因后果。
examples.en: He told the teacher how the fight started and what happened.

usage.en: Object; often 事情的前因后果.

meaning.en: To express neither agreement nor disagreement.
meaning.zh: 不说行，也不说不行，不表明态度。

examples.zh: 对于我的建议，经理不置可否。
examples.en: The manager was non-committal about my proposal.

examples.zh: 她只是笑了笑，不置可否。
examples.en: She just smiled and said neither yes nor no.

examples.zh: 官方对这一传闻不置可否。
examples.en: Officials would neither confirm nor deny the rumour.

meaning.en: The tiniest amount; (with a negative) not at all.
meaning.zh: 极小的数量，多用于否定。

examples.zh: 这件事他没有一丝一毫的责任。
examples.en: He bears not the slightest responsibility for this.

examples.zh: 工作中不能有一丝一毫的马虎。
examples.en: There's no room for even the slightest carelessness at work.

examples.zh: 他不肯让一丝一毫。
examples.en: He refuses to give an inch.

usage.en: Attributive or object; mostly in negatives.
usage.zh: 多作定语、宾语，多用于否定句。

meaning.en: To attend to one thing only to neglect another.
meaning.zh: 顾了这个，丢了那个，形容无法全面照顾。

equivalents: unable to cope with everything at once
have too many balls in the air

examples.zh: 一个人管三个部门，难免顾此失彼。
examples.en: Running three departments alone, he can't help dropping some balls.

examples.zh: 又要上班又要带孩子，她常常顾此失彼。
examples.en: Juggling work and childcare, she often can't keep on top of both.

examples.zh: 复习要全面，不要顾此失彼。
examples.en: Revise thoroughly — don't focus on one subject and neglect the rest.

synonyms: 狗熊掰包谷——掰一个丢一个
鸵鸟钻沙堆——顾头不顾尾

meaning.en: Of no help to the situation.
meaning.zh: 对事情没有任何帮助。

examples.zh: 事情已经发生了，后悔也于事无补。
examples.en: It's already happened; regretting it won't help.

examples.zh: 光发脾气于事无补。
examples.en: Losing your temper gets you nowhere.

examples.zh: 现在道歉已经于事无补了。
examples.en: Apologising now won't change anything.

meaning.en: To put on make-up and go on stage; figuratively (derogatory), to enter politics or public life.
meaning.zh: 化装上台演戏，今多比喻坏人登上政治舞台（含讽刺意味）。

examples.zh: 各路候选人纷纷粉墨登场。
examples.en: Candidates of every stripe are strutting onto the political stage.

examples.zh: 几个骗子粉墨登场，自称专家。
examples.en: A few conmen took the stage, calling themselves experts.

examples.zh: 这位老艺人八十岁还粉墨登场。
examples.en: At eighty, the veteran performer still puts on the make-up and takes the stage.

usage.zh: 多作谓语；比喻义含讽刺。

meaning.en: Constantly changing in countless ways.
meaning.zh: 形容变化非常多。

examples.zh: 天上的云千变万化。
examples.en: The clouds in the sky are forever changing shape.

examples.zh: 市场千变万化，企业必须灵活应对。
examples.en: Markets are always shifting, so companies must adapt.

examples.zh: 中国菜的做法千变万化。
examples.en: There are endless ways of cooking Chinese food.

story.en: Liezi describes a magician from the far west whose powers could bring about 'a thousand changes and ten thousand transformations, endlessly' (千变万化，不可穷极).
story.zh: 《列子·周穆王》：“千变万化，不可穷极。”

natural: see the light of day again

meaning.en: To be freed from darkness or oppression; to come to light again.
meaning.zh: 重新看见天空和太阳，比喻脱离黑暗，重获光明。

equivalents: see the light of day again

examples.zh: 被冤枉的他终于重见天日。
examples.en: Wrongly convicted, he was finally set free.

examples.zh: 这批文物在地下埋了千年，今天重见天日。
examples.en: Buried for a thousand years, these relics have seen the light of day again.

examples.zh: 被困矿工经过五天营救重见天日。
examples.en: After five days the trapped miners were brought back to the surface.

meaning.en: Defying all law and authority; utterly unruly.
meaning.zh: 不顾国法，不顾天理，形容毫无顾忌地胡作非为。

examples.zh: 这些人无法无天，竟敢当众打人。
examples.en: These thugs are so lawless they beat people up in public.

examples.zh: 孩子被宠得无法无天。
examples.en: The child has been spoiled until he's completely out of control.

examples.zh: 那个年代社会上无法无天。
examples.en: Lawlessness reigned in those days.

synonyms: 癞痢头撑伞——无法（发）无天

meaning.en: Utterly and seriously wrong.
meaning.zh: 错得非常厉害。

examples.zh: 你要是以为我会放弃，那就大错特错了。
examples.en: If you think I'll give up, you're dead wrong.

examples.zh: 把孩子交给手机带，这种做法大错特错。
examples.en: Leaving children to be raised by their phones is completely wrong.

examples.zh: 他以为钱能解决一切，真是大错特错。
examples.en: He thinks money can solve everything — how wrong he is.

usage.en: Predicate; often 那就大错特错了.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“那就大错特错了”。

meaning.en: Not a single grain harvested; a complete crop failure or total loss.
meaning.zh: 一粒粮食也没收到，形容严重歉收，也比喻毫无收获。

examples.zh: 大旱之年，这里颗粒无收。
examples.en: In the drought year, the crops failed completely here.

examples.zh: 一场冰雹让果农颗粒无收。
examples.en: One hailstorm wiped out the fruit farmers' entire harvest.

examples.zh: 这次参展颗粒无收，一个订单也没拿到。
examples.en: We came away from the trade fair empty-handed — not a single order.

meaning.en: To not take something seriously; to pay it no attention.
meaning.zh: 不放在心上，表示不重视。

examples.zh: 医生提醒他戒烟，他却不以为意。
examples.en: The doctor told him to stop smoking, but he shrugged it off.

examples.zh: 大家都笑他，他倒不以为意。
examples.en: Everyone laughed at him, but he didn't mind.

examples.zh: 小问题不以为意，最后酿成了大祸。
examples.en: Small problems ignored ended in disaster.

usage.en: Predicate. Do not confuse with 不以为然 'disagree'.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。注意与“不以为然”（不认为是对的）区别。

meaning.en: Flustered and furious, out of control with anger or panic.
meaning.zh: 上气不接下气，狼狈不堪，形容十分慌张或恼怒。

examples.zh: 被揭穿后，他气急败坏地骂了起来。
examples.en: Exposed, he flew into a rage and started swearing.

examples.zh: 输了比赛，对方教练气急败坏。
examples.en: Having lost, the opposing coach was beside himself with fury.

examples.zh: 她气急败坏地跑来告诉我钱包丢了。
examples.en: She came rushing over in a flap to tell me her purse was gone.
